ifHostOverrules.obj1: there is no along-wire value to approve. If the intent is "get MCU-34 off the digits", the least-bad candidates are s=12.5 (presses PA10 instead) or s=39.5 (presses the flag name), both of which move the defect rather than remove it. Neither is recommended.
ifHostOverrules.obj2: no value to approve either: s=32.5 clears PB10 and 21 but lands on attr102, and every s>=15 adds a GND press.
ifHostOverrules.conclusion: a real fix for D2/D3 cannot be a translation along these wires. It needs a change of class (re-space the row, move the flag/label to another row, or shift the wires), which is a different task and was not rehearsed here.
